# @thewaver/ss-utils

> Geometry, CSS, SVG and DOM helpers for building shaped UI. Framework-agnostic: no dependency on
> `solid-js` or any other UI library. Every export carries a doc comment (what it takes, what it
> returns, what it guarantees) — read `dist/index.d.ts` for ground truth on any single export.

Sibling package: `@thewaver/ss-components` is built on this, but this package works standalone.

## Exports

### Abstracts — geometry and math, no DOM dependency
angle, bitwise, bounds, color, decimal, dir, easing, function, gesture, index2d, math, matrix3d,
object, point2d, point3d, polygon, random, rect, rotation, shape, size, string, time, vec2d,
vec3d, vec4d.

### Web — browser-facing helpers
CSS (including keyframe generation), DOM, Audio, SVG, JSX text metrics and JSX text parsing, io.

### TypeScript — shared generic type utilities
typeUtils.
